children: Patriot National Bancorp entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with accredited investors for a registered direct equity offering. The company sold 4,782,608 shares at $1.15 per share and issued 956,522 five-year warrants, exercisable six months after closing at $1.25 per share. Gross proceeds are expected to be approximately $5.5 million before an estimated $350,000 in expenses. Proceeds will fund capital at Patriot Bank and general corporate purposes; no underwriter participated.
: Securities Purchase Agreement for registered direct offering of common stock and warrants
: Raise capital for Patriot Bank and general corporate purposes
